---
name: "Feature Request"
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement.
title: "[FEAT] - "
labels: feature
assignees: ''

---

## Type of Request
- [ ] New Sport Integration (e.g., Ping Pong, Foosball, Padel — Basketball is a future extension)
- [ ] Core Flow Enhancement (e.g., ELO, Match validation, Queueing)
- [ ] External Service / Hardware API (e.g., GPS, QR scanner, Maps, Weather)
- [ ] UI / Responsiveness Improvement
- [ ] Offline Persistence / Firestore Caching
- [ ] Arena Assistant Enhancement (read-only tools, orchestration, answer cards — chatbot never writes to Firestore)

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## Proposed Implementation
- How does this fit into the existing facility-centric structure?
- Does it require updates to the Firestore schema or Firestore offline persistence configuration?
- What are the UI/responsive layout requirements (e.g., LayoutBuilder, MediaQuery split-view constraints)?

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Feature functions as described.
- [ ] Unit or widget tests are implemented.
- [ ] Documentation in the Design Document is updated.
